# lernapps.net tooling

> Build, check and list learning apps for lernapps.net with an AI assistant. The package @lernapps/tooling is on npm.

## Before you start: check the entry criteria

1. **A shell:** you can run commands, with Node 22.18 or newer, git, and `npm` reaching npmjs.com. If not (a chat in
   the browser, such as chatgpt.com, usually cannot): **stop here and do nothing else.** Tell the creator in two
   sentences that this does not work in this environment and that they should start again in one that does, such as
   the desktop application of their AI assistant, with the same request. Do not build the app by hand from this page.
2. **`npx` may run:** your harness lets you run `npx --yes @lernapps/tooling …` (it runs a package from npm). If its
   permissions block it (an auto mode that refuses code from the internet), tell the creator in two sentences how to
   allow it, e.g. in Claude Code a permission rule `Bash(npx --yes @lernapps/tooling:*)`, and wait. Never work around
   the block. Until it is allowed, start with the fallback below; building the app (Code) needs `npx`.
3. **An empty folder:** the app is the folder you start in. Work in it, never in a subfolder.

## Build an app

1. In the empty folder run `npx --yes @lernapps/tooling init <short name>`. It writes the plan template, complete and
   unchanged, as `.vibe/plans/01-<short name>.md`, `AGENTS.md` (every process rule, also below on this page),
   `CLAUDE.md` and the skills of the phases.
2. Read the plan in full. Follow it task by task: it gives the order, names the skills of each phase and holds the
   creator's checkpoints. The process rules of `AGENTS.md` hold in every phase.

Read guidance from the file, in full. Nothing is downloaded: a fetch tool that summarises loses tasks and rules, and
`init` copies the files as they are.

### Fallback: without `npx`, for Explore and Plan

When `npx` may not run yet, the same files come from the repository https://github.com/lernapps/tooling:

1. `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lernapps/tooling` into a temporary folder, not into the app's folder.
2. Copy into the app's folder, unchanged: `guidance/plan-template.md` as `.vibe/plans/01-<short name>.md`,
   `guidance/AGENTS.md` as `AGENTS.md`; write `CLAUDE.md` with the one line `@AGENTS.md`; copy the folders
   `skills/process/*`, `skills/content/*` and `skills/tooling/*` into `.agents/skills/` (each skill a folder with its
   `SKILL.md`).
3. Follow the plan through Explore and Plan. Before Code, `npx` must run: in the same folder, `npx --yes
   @lernapps/tooling init <short name>` (the same short name) installs the packages and writes the files again; it
   keeps the plan you filled in. Without the packages there is no app.

## Change a published app

- In the app's repo, `AGENTS.md` leads to the current plan and the increment template.

## Reference

Look things up here when you need them. Not needed for building.

- Rules by id: https://lernapps.net/tooling/rules/ (check messages link `#<id>`).
- Platform rules for an app built without this tooling (by hand, another framework, an app builder):
  node_modules/@lernapps/tooling/skills/tooling/lernapps-cli/references/platform-rules.md (after `npx --yes @lernapps/tooling init`)
- Check a built or published app: `npx --yes @lernapps/tooling check <dir|url>`. Every
  command lists its options with `--help`.
- Schemas: validation report https://lernapps.net/tooling/schemas/validation-report.v1.schema.json, review verdict
  https://lernapps.net/tooling/schemas/verdict.v1.schema.json, catalog entry
  https://lernapps.net/apps/schemas/entry.v1.schema.json. The schemas of a quiz and of an explainer are in the app:
  node_modules/@lernapps/app-templates/runtime/quiz/quiz.v1.schema.json and .../explainer/explainer.v1.schema.json.
- GitHub, explained for creators: https://lernapps.net/tooling/github/
- Keeping an app up to date, the two GitHub Apps and the settings: https://lernapps.net/tooling/github/updates/
- Which assistant to build with, and three apps a budget model built: https://lernapps.net/tooling/assistants/
- How we test the guidance, with eval results: https://lernapps.net/tooling/prompt-engineering/
- Architecture: https://lernapps.net/tooling/architecture/

## Other llms.txt of lernapps.net

- lernapps.net, where to find what: https://lernapps.net/llms.txt
- Docs: https://lernapps.net/docs/llms.txt
- Catalog: https://lernapps.net/apps/llms.txt; listing an app: https://lernapps.net/apps/enter/llms.txt

The process rules follow below: `AGENTS.md`, the file `init` writes into every app, as it is in this version.
